title: Case 022: Lost card blocked
initial_request: I noticed my H&V debit card was missing after a visit to Alder Quay Market. Please block it immediately.
overview: After completing H&V's identification checks on a call, Mara Ellison asked for her missing card to be blocked. The agent escalated case HV-022 and submitted the verified instruction to H&V's card system. The card journal confirmed the card was marked blocked, and H&V notified Mara through the secure portal.

next_action.summary: Submit the verified block instruction to H&V's card system.

outcome: The card journal confirmed that the card was marked blocked. Any disputed transactions remain a separate matter for review; no outcome on them is recorded here.
